name: Project, resource, storage and loader core
scope: Discover plain Markdown and managed structured resources.
Implement `$docengine` envelope parsing, schema validation and resource identity.
Implement immutable generic structured objects and adapters.
Enforce mirrored `_structured/` convention and materialization path confinement.

pre_execution_questions.question: Как engine находит project/documentation root при запуске?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: Ошибочная discovery-логика может заставить AI работать не с тем деревом.
pre_execution_questions.recommended_default: Priority: explicit `--project-root`/`--docs-root` > project config > upward search from cwd; never guess across filesystem boundaries.
pre_execution_questions.answer: Priority: explicit `--project-root`/`--docs-root` > project config > upward search from cwd; never guess across filesystem boundaries.
pre_execution_questions.decision: Adopt safe deterministic root discovery with strict path confinement.
pre_execution_questions.acceptance_impact: Must be resolved before phase acceptance.

pre_execution_questions.question: Где хранить project-level config и как его назвать?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: Structured data принадлежит docs, но engine registration/config нужна всему project.
pre_execution_questions.recommended_default: `docengine.toml` в project root; documentation-owned structured/runtime data остаётся under docs.
pre_execution_questions.answer: `docengine.toml` в project root; documentation-owned structured/runtime data остаётся under docs.
pre_execution_questions.decision: Adopt this implementation default for v0.1 unless implementation evidence exposes a contradiction.
pre_execution_questions.acceptance_impact: Must be resolved before phase acceptance.

pre_execution_questions.question: Каким будет базовый runtime object representation для произвольных JSON schemas?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: Нужно сохранить generic loading без генерации project-specific классов вручную.
pre_execution_questions.recommended_default: Immutable generic mapping/object wrapper with field/path access; optional project adapters/dataclasses may layer on top.
pre_execution_questions.answer: Immutable generic mapping/object wrapper with field/path access; optional project adapters/dataclasses may layer on top.
pre_execution_questions.decision: Adopt this implementation default for v0.1 unless implementation evidence exposes a contradiction.
pre_execution_questions.acceptance_impact: Must be resolved before phase acceptance.

pre_execution_questions.question: Фиксируем ли exact ResourceRef syntax уже в P1?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: Receipts, baselines and project code будут зависеть от стабильного адресного формата.
pre_execution_questions.recommended_default: Yes: `resource://<namespace>/<id>#/<json-pointer>` for structured resources and `file://<docs-relative-path>` for files; escaping follows URI + JSON Pointer rules.
pre_execution_questions.answer: Yes: `resource://<namespace>/<id>#/<json-pointer>` for structured resources and `file://<docs-relative-path>` for files; escaping follows URI + JSON Pointer rules.
pre_execution_questions.decision: Adopt this implementation default for v0.1 unless implementation evidence exposes a contradiction.
pre_execution_questions.acceptance_impact: Must be resolved before phase acceptance.

emergent_questions.question: Как разрешить обнаруженное расхождение между старыми docs-примерами `resource://policies.method_policy` и уже принятым Q1.4 форматом `resource://<namespace>/<id>`?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Receipts/builders/baselines следующих фаз должны опираться на один канонический ref format.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Q1.4/phase contract имеет приоритет; исправить старые docs examples и тестировать round-trip.
emergent_questions.answer: Использовать `resource://<namespace>/<id>#/<json-pointer>`; dotted resource_id отображается как namespace + local id.
emergent_questions.decision: Старые dot-form URI examples исправлены; canonical parser/formatter реализован и malformed/ambiguous refs rejected.

emergent_questions.question: Нужна ли обязательная runtime dependency на полный `jsonschema` validator уже в P1?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Полная dependency увеличивает distribution surface, но silent partial validation также недопустима.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Сохранить stdlib-first core: явный validator adapter + строгий небольшой v0.1 subset; unsupported keywords должны fail, а не игнорироваться.
emergent_questions.answer: Обязательную dependency не добавлять в P1; реализовать `SchemaValidator` boundary и `CoreSchemaValidator` с explicit supported subset.
emergent_questions.decision: P1 runtime остаётся dependency-free; unknown schema URI, malformed schema и unsupported semantic keyword дают явную ошибку.

emergent_questions.question: `docs/_structured/` mirror — только рекомендация или runtime invariant для Markdown materialization в v0.1?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Без enforcement JSON может физически выглядеть принадлежащим одному документу, но владеть несвязанным Markdown path.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Для Markdown outputs enforce single mirrored target; non-Markdown outputs могут иметь отдельные explicit targets.
emergent_questions.answer: Enforce mirror rule for Markdown materialization in v0.1.
emergent_questions.decision: `_structured/a/b.json` с Markdown output обязан владеть `a/b.md`; mismatch is ResourceError.

emergent_questions.question: Должен ли P1 distribution иметь новую runtime build version относительно P0?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Два различных wheel с одинаковой version делают provenance/handoff неоднозначными.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Increment development build identity while target stable runtime remains 0.1.0.
emergent_questions.decision: `pyproject.toml` и `ENGINE_VERSION` синхронно обновлены до `0.1.0.dev1`; persisted/machine schema versions не изменены.

emergent_questions.question: Как P1 должен обращаться с symlink/path edge cases для config, structured sources и Markdown inventory?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Symlink может обойти lexical path confinement и вывести reads/writes за project/docs roots.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Resolve real paths for confinement; reject config symlink during init and reject documentation/structured escapes.
emergent_questions.answer: Следовать real-path confinement; `docengine.toml` symlink не использовать для v0.1 initialization/config loading.
emergent_questions.decision: Добавлены checks и regression tests для dangling config symlink, docs symlink outside, structured-dir escape и plain Markdown symlink escape.

emergent_questions.question: Должен ли source-package test extra явно включать pytest, если canonical reproduction command использует `python -m pytest`?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Иначе handoff source environment не полностью описывает собственный test harness, даже если runtime wheel не требует pytest.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Да; добавить pytest только в optional `test` extra, не в runtime dependencies.
emergent_questions.answer: Да; `pytest>=8,<9` добавлен в optional test dependencies рядом с jsonschema.
emergent_questions.decision: Runtime dependency list остаётся пустым; wheel metadata содержит pytest/jsonschema только под extra `test`.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Improves DAX19 source-harness reproducibility without changing runtime portability.

emergent_questions.question: Как upward discovery должен трактовать dangling/non-file `docengine.toml` marker в родительском каталоге?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Игнорирование malformed marker позволяло ошибочно считать вложенный cwd новым project root и `init` мог записать новый проект не там, где ожидалось.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Лексическое наличие marker останавливает upward search; затем config loader обязан явно отклонить symlink/non-file marker.
emergent_questions.answer: Лексическое наличие marker теперь останавливает search даже для dangling symlink/не-файла.
emergent_questions.decision: `_find_project_root` использует marker presence, а не только `is_file()`; malformed marker приводит к явной ошибке, не к silent fallback.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Required to retain DAX03/DAX04 pass for P1 scope.

emergent_questions.question: Могут ли `structured_dir` и `dependency_dir` совпадать/пересекаться, и могут ли materialization outputs писать внутрь этих reserved trees?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Пересечение или generated writes в reserved trees могут смешать canonical structured data, dependency state и generated outputs.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Reserved trees должны быть disjoint; materialization внутрь любого reserved tree запрещена.
emergent_questions.answer: Нет: reserved trees должны быть disjoint, dedicated subtrees, а generated output не может их таргетировать.
emergent_questions.decision: Config validation rejects equal/ancestor overlap/`.`; materialization validation rejects targets under structured/dependency roots for every renderer.

emergent_questions.question: Должен ли strict JSON loader отклонять numeric literals, которые Python преобразует в `inf` из-за overflow (например `1e999`)?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Иначе canonical JSON может породить non-finite runtime value и позднее нестабильный hash/serialization.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Да, все runtime numeric values из canonical JSON должны оставаться finite.
emergent_questions.answer: Да; overflow-to-infinity запрещён так же, как NaN/Infinity literals.
emergent_questions.decision: Добавлен strict `parse_float` finite check и regression tests.

emergent_questions.question: Должен ли active `dist/` содержать исторические wheels вместе с текущим?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Несколько версий одного package в `dist/*.whl` дают ambiguous/conflicting install и ломают handoff.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Нет; `dist/` содержит ровно один current wheel. Исторические wheels хранятся только в phase evidence.
emergent_questions.answer: Нет. Active dist должен содержать ровно текущую distribution.
emergent_questions.decision: P0/P1 historical wheels перенесены в `plan/evidence/<phase>/artifacts/`; spec audit проверяет exactly-one current wheel + version/metadata identity. Runtime build bumped to 0.1.0.dev2.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Adds/fixes DAX20 coverage for P1 handoff.

emergent_questions.question: Должен ли DAX20 быть mapped axis P1, если каждый phase выпускает новый manifest/wheel/README/transferable archive?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Без mapping package/handoff defects могут не попасть в обязательный phase review.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Да; любой phase, который изменяет distributable handoff package, должен review DAX20 for its scope.
emergent_questions.answer: Да; P1 materially changes distribution/handoff and therefore maps DAX20.
emergent_questions.decision: DAX20 добавлен в P1.acceptance_axes и axis_reviews; P8 всё равно выполняет global consolidated closure.

emergent_questions.question: Должен ли передаваемый source checkout запускать canonical test suite без ручного PYTHONPATH или предварительной установки package?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: AI/другой чат должен уметь проверить архив одной документированной командой без скрытого shell state.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Да; `python -m pytest -q` из project root должен работать непосредственно из checkout.
emergent_questions.answer: Да. Source checkout должен быть self-contained для запуска тестов.
emergent_questions.decision: Добавлен `[tool.pytest.ini_options] pythonpath=["src"]`; README/START_HERE используют bare `python -m pytest -q`; regression test фиксирует contract.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Required to retain DAX19 pass for P1 scope.

implementation_log.entry: Implemented versioned project config contract, safe root discovery and idempotent project initialization without Markdown promotion.
Implemented strict canonical JSON loading, project schema registry/adapter and explicit subset validation.
Implemented canonical ResourceRef/FieldRef parsing, JSON Pointer semantics and immutable generic RawObject representation.
Implemented managed resource loader/catalog/resolver/version helper with plain/managed/derived/generated inventory classes.
Enforced documentation-root materialization confinement, mirrored `_structured` Markdown ownership and symlink escape safety.
Updated sample project with project config and project-owned schemas used by runtime loading.
Built runtime wheel 0.1.0.dev1 and exercised installed `init`/`resources` in a clean virtual environment.
Completed P1 candidate full-suite/spec/package verification and froze acceptance evidence.
Independent post-acceptance axis audit fixed malformed upward config-marker fallback, reserved-tree overlap/materialization hazards and strict-JSON float overflow.
Handoff/distribution audit moved historical wheels out of active dist, added exactly-one-current-wheel audit, mapped DAX20 to P1 and advanced runtime build identity to 0.1.0.dev2.
Completed independent P1 axis-correction candidate run: expanded tests, clean dev2 wheel install, wildcard active-dist install, installed init/resources/plain inventory and pip check all pass.

findings: Post-acceptance audit found and fixed reserved-tree overlap/output-target hazards.
Post-acceptance audit found and fixed malformed-marker fallback and float-overflow acceptance.
Post-acceptance audit found and fixed malformed-marker fallback and generated writes into reserved state trees.
Regression coverage expanded by independent axis audit.
Source-checkout import path gap was found after interruption and fixed; bare `python -m pytest -q` now works from project root.
Initial P1 package incorrectly retained both dev0 and dev1 wheels in active dist; corrected so active dist has exactly one current wheel and historical wheels live under phase evidence.
Final audit now verifies wheel/source Python parity and rejects transient build/ in the transferable package.

acceptance_summary.notes: Post-acceptance independent axis audit completed; P1-scope defects corrected. Phase-local PASS does not imply global axis closure before P8.
